assumptions: Reference one US tractor entity uses ATRI less-than26 truck group; not selection of an actual carrier.
MX IMT2025 flat-road40ft consumption is transferred to dryvan53ft loaded and bobtail empty as a constant prospective hypothesis, not calibration or guaranteed conservatism.
US ORNL2006-2008 heavy gross-weight bin7.9mpg is transferred to loaded and empty movement; no pilot payload or light-bin certified-empty claim.
MX national retail Sep25 and US PADD3 retail Sep28 are dated prices, not corridor receipts or discounts. Taxes included/unresolved recoverability are not normalized net economic prices.

Maintenance and tires preserve historical MX2025 net model and US2024 TTI estimated costs. This heterogeneous-period projection is not a jointly observed carrier cohort or inflation-adjusted benchmark.
MX bobtail recovery in network has no defensible tractor-only maintenance split; that missing amount stays null. Dedicated return is attached in both countries.
US maintenance lubricant inclusion is unresolved; do not add MX lube or invent US lube and DEF zero.
Physical movement km are assumed paid once. MX2.10 perkm is advertised pay, not full employer cost; US0.817 per mile is reported wages plus benefits excluding incentives/bonuses.
No weekly salary, ECEC payroll, extra federal taxes or separate shared-box mileage charge is added again.
Idle fuel, waiting pay, tolls, crossing services, full employer burden, missing fixed coverages and financed box remain unresolved, not zero.
